entry_points.text: Fault entries validate low 32 bits, flush speculation, trace fresh faults or sleep for completions, adjust privacy, try MMIO, then map with emulation fallback; alias or dummy warns.
Builder clears host bits, resolves frame and slot, selects TDP or legacy worker with fast path, converts private emulation to exit, and propagates level.
Emulation validates vendor permission, decodes with breakpoint checks, handles skip and intercept outcomes, and routes vectors to debug, page-fault or queued delivery.
Invalidation covers global or matched roots; config stores TDP bounds and huge tier; prefault maps ranges rejecting disallowed and aliased; failures build error envelopes.

exports.text: Guest memory services validate binding, ensure currency, convert privacy, and return host frame with writability and pinned page under shared guard.
Async helpers report tracked frames and whether handling is allowed.
Mapping services install TDP entries, invalidate addresses, reuse roots on PGD change, and complete async faults.
Emulation decodes and executes instructions, injects exceptions, reports vectoring failures, and accounts branches with masked flags.
Nested shadow builds NPT and EPT contexts; write tracking locates entries under address-space lock; dump logs the walk.

hazards.text: Atomic reads reject cross-page ranges and error mappings, copy without faults, and map shortfalls to fault errors.
Table types distinguish EPT (18) from 64-bit and 32-bit paging; batch zap covers ten pages.
Backdoor uses narrow port and counter opcodes; soft interrupts validated against embedded vector.

ABI: async enabled, delivery, always-send, pf-vmexit; slots gmem, RO, invalid, APIC-private; results continue, retry, emulate, WP, fixed, spurious, invalid; errors mask plus IO, RO, no-slot, host-addr; faults private, reserved, synthetic; write, nowait, interruptible; halt, free-root, capacity.

invariants.text: Async needs enabled plus delivery; denied for protected guests, privilege zero, disabled paging, or nested without opt-in.
Async refused without LAPIC, on reinjection or exception, halted-undeliverable, or masked interrupts; table probes to empty marker.
Index is offset plus file offset; defaults private; host frame is folio base plus remainder; locked first, zeroed before current.
Faults start unwritable; read-only forces unwritable; error mask marks bad frames; gmem needs gmem slot else exit; APIC emulates; deleted or moved retries.
Fault is stale on obsolete root, pending free, or overlapping invalidation under lock; sequence taken with barrier before privacy check.
Guest-table write needs three bits; retry only when marked and never on shadowed writes.
Directness selects mirrored or normal root with backing page for mirrored; roles encode depth and rights; EPT masks rebuilt; cache prefers current.
Emulation starts isolated with derived mode; debug honors host, scans four regs, coalesces shadow, classifies vectors; L1TF per-CPU.
Prefault retries transient and maps fixed or WP to success; MMIO refreshes on match; fetch merges PAE; flooded or misaligned zaps; rmap delegates.

locks.text: Release asserts MMU lock except retry; dirty needs lock so fast faults defer; unsafe uses volatile; lookup returns locked, warns on rebind, never maps poison.
TDP holds shared guard under RCU across staleness, install and accounting; invalidation holds exclusive and warns on wrong-MMU; gmem asserted; frozen retries.
Split readiness needs no resched plus minima; topup asserts slot lock and refills; callers drop and retake address-space lock with retry; low pages fail no-space.

state_machines.text: IO faults halt-retry on duplicates or set up async then retry, else block; TDP tracks, fast-resolves, prepares, then installs with spurious and flush handling.
Write protection rejects repeats and MMIO hits, tries unprotect-retry, else emulates without nested retry; failures inject or report to userspace.
Huge split gets direct child, populates small entries with rmap, links and restarts; collapsible zap restarts; full zap prepares, commits, extends to TDP.

structs.text: MMU creation starts roots invalid, wires contexts and caches; VM setup copies MMIO marker, inits lists and locks, wires split caches; fails no-memory when root alloc fails.
Internal faultin resolves backing frame; finish runs accounting; leaf iterator holds old entry, level and frame.
Root cache keeps one current plus retained roots with page, address-space id and role governing reuse.
